lastCompletedStory.title: Refactor runSidecar and ConfigScreen under biome complexity/line limits (pure refactor)

nextStoryContext: US-010 was a pure biome refactor story. Two violations fixed: (1) runSidecar (sidecar.ts) extracted a buildSidecarLoopDeps helper that absorbs the 12+ ?? and ternary operators, reducing runSidecar complexity from 18 to 2, line count from 88 to 31. (2) ConfigScreen (ConfigScreen.tsx) extracted BackendSection, MergeModeSection, PlanApprovalSection as internal helper components, reducing ConfigScreen complexity from 20 to ~14, lines from 98 to ~67. No per-file biome overrides added (oracle: grep -Eq passes). file-size-budget.json raised sidecar.ts ceiling from 512 to 540 (helper extraction grows file; expected per notes; _ref CAM-109 already present). All 1892 tests pass. bun run check:all exits 0. This was the final story in CAM-109 (US-010 was the last passes:false). The PRD should now be COMPLETE (all non-operator stories pass); run /cam-review to confirm.
